moves.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

moves.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sandstorm. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are a Ground, Rock, or Steel type, or have the Sand Veil Ability. Fails if the current weather is Sandstorm.

moves.shortDesc: For 5 turns, a sandstorm rages.

moves.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded down.

moves.name: Uproar
